# 5Zen Technologies

> 5Zen Technologies is a modern IT and software solutions company based in Tamil Nadu, India. We design and develop custom websites, web applications, mobile applications, SaaS platforms, AI-powered solutions, and digital automation systems for businesses worldwide.

## Company Identity
- **Legal Name**: 5Zen Technologies
- **Short Name**: 5Zen Tech / 5Zen
- **Primary Domain**: https://5zentech.com
- **Official Contact Email**: info@5zentech.com
- **Location**: Tamil Nadu, India (Remote Worldwide)
- **Tagline**: Connect. Create. Elevate.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Web Development**: Custom high-performance websites built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern CSS. Fully responsive, SEO-optimized, and lightning fast.
- **Web Application Development**: Full-stack web applications, custom dashboards, client portals, and administrative platforms.
- **Mobile Application Development**: iOS and Android mobile app development using React Native and Flutter.
- **Custom Software Development**: Enterprise software, specialized business tools, custom CRM/ERP integrations, and database architectures.
- **SaaS Development**: Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, subscription management, payment gateway integration, and scalable cloud architectures.
- **AI & Business Automation**: Custom AI-powered tools, LLM integrations, document parsing, workflow automation, and intelligent chatbots.
- **Cloud Solutions**: Infrastructure setup, API development, cloud deployment (Vercel, AWS, GCP), and technical maintenance.

## Key Verified Case Studies & Projects
- **Bali Droom Villas**: Modern luxury villa booking & rental platform.
- **GEN B BIKE CARE**: Digital bike service booking & workshop management system.
- **ExpenseMate**: Smart multi-currency personal & team expense tracker.
- **MAVIO**: AI-powered social media post generator and content scheduling SaaS.
- **Restaurant Booking System**: Real-time table reservation and online menu management system.
- **E-Commerce Solution**: Scalable multi-category e-commerce storefront with payment processing.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, HTML5, CSS3.
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Express, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL.
- **Databases & Storage**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Redis.
- **Deployment & Cloud**: Vercel, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, Docker.
